title: Student-Path Syllabus Node Pre-Seeded Approved on Tree Init
description: The agent module shall set the syllabus node status to approved when initialising a student tree-mode course.
rationale: On the student path the syllabus was already approved during the intake flow; inserting it as approved avoids a redundant second HITL gate for content the student already accepted, while the first active gate at section_goal preserves the HITL-per-level contract.
